interpretation.conditioning: T_r=sum_causal s^r V/r!, u=r!c. Native-output J uses the RMS Jacobian at the recorded rounded y; smooth J uses y=T u. Tangents exclude coefficient radius only. Direction singular values multiply coefficient-tangent singular values by ||u||. Early causal prefixes may be structurally rank deficient.
interpretation.forward_rounding: Hold the upstream task cotangent fixed and compare FP64 RMS-composed coefficient gradients at native rounded y versus smooth y=T u.
interpretation.kernel_vjp: Compare Mosaic dL/du with T^T times the recorded BF16 raw-output cotangent from the instrumented graph; isolates polynomial-kernel derivative arithmetic from RMS amplification. FP64 uses the exact captured BF16 operands but higher-precision score accumulation.
interpretation.limits: One fitting sequence, not B256 gradient or clipping statistics. The before/after causal activations differ. Cotangents come from each instrumented compiled model's own sequence NLL; failed capture/native parity is explicitly labeled and never excused by widening its bound. Native checkpoint identity/NLL replay and unchanged parameter arrays remain hard requirements. FP64 smooth derivatives differ from mixed-precision surrogate derivatives; numerical discrepancies are reported without an invented derivative pass threshold. No trained parameter, optimizer state, or checkpoint is changed.
interpretation.rms_backward: Compare actual BF16 raw-output cotangent with the independent FP64 RMS Jacobian at the same native raw output.

sampling: Endpoint-inclusive uniform queries plus each layer/head's minimum raw-output-RMS query; full original causal keys in every reference.

after.cotangent_execution: Instrumented compiled execution with capture/native NLL discrepancy beyond the established bound; these are not claimed to be the native checkpoint's exact cotangents.

fp32_capture_control.interpretation: Same before/after checkpoint arrays and sequence. Native and instrumented graphs both use FP32 module arithmetic with blocked attention. The loss is not required to equal BF16 checkpoint NLL; changing the backend as well as arithmetic prevents attributing any difference to one precise cause.

before.cotangent_execution: Instrumented compiled execution; native/capture NLL agrees within the established bound, but bitwise identity is not asserted.

fp32_capture_control.interpretation: Same before/after checkpoint arrays and sequence. Native and instrumented graphs both use FP32 module arithmetic with blocked attention. The loss is not required to equal BF16 checkpoint NLL; changing the backend as well as arithmetic prevents attributing any difference to one precise cause.
